definitions.gloss: cumulative total; running total; aggregate sum
definitions.explanation: the total amount accumulated over a period of time by adding successive amounts together

examples.japanese: {累計|るいけい}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百万部|ひゃくまんぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: Cumulative sales have exceeded one million copies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{累計|るいけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{五千万円|ごせんまんえん}です。
examples.english: The cumulative total up to this month is 50 million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感染者|かんせんしゃ}→感染者：28388_kansensha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{累計|るいけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The cumulative number of infected people was announced.

notes:
FORMS:
{累|るい} (accumulate, pile up) + ⟦{計|けい}→計：02691_kei⟧ (total, calculation) → accumulated total

CAN FUNCTION AS:
- Noun: {累計|るいけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (in cumulative terms)
- No-adjective: {累計|るいけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧ (cumulative sales)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {累計|るいけい}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧/{部数|ぶすう} (cumulative sales/copies)
- {累計|るいけい}⟦{来場者|らいじょうしゃ}→来場者：19023_raijousha⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (cumulative visitors)
- {累計|るいけい}⟦{利用者|りようしゃ}→利用者：03189_riyousha⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (cumulative users)
- {累計|るいけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧～⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧/⟦{億|おく}→億：17935_oku⟧ (cumulative total of ~ million/billion)

USAGE:
Frequently used in:
- Sales reports and business news
- Statistics and data reporting
- Public health announcements
- Economic indicators

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{合計|ごうけい}→合計：02817_goukei⟧ (total, sum)
- ⟦{総計|そうけい}→総計：15248_soukei⟧ (grand total)
- ⟦{月間|げっかん}→月間：13077_gekkan⟧/⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧ (monthly/annual - often contrasted with cumulative)
